005package org.wpilib.driverstation;
006
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.wpilib.event.BooleanEvent;
009import org.wpilib.event.EventLoop;
010import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
011
012/**
013 * Handle input from Flight Joysticks connected to the Driver Station.
014 *
015 * <p>This class handles standard input that comes from the Driver Station. Each time a value is
016 * requested the most recent value is returned. There is a single class instance for each joystick
017 * and the mapping of ports to hardware buttons depends on the code in the Driver Station.
018 */
019public class Joystick implements HIDDevice {
020  /** Default X axis channel. */
021  public static final byte DEFAULT_X_CHANNEL = 0;
022
023  /** Default Y axis channel. */
024  public static final byte DEFAULT_Y_CHANNEL = 1;
025
026  /** Default Z axis channel. */
027  public static final byte DEFAULT_Z_CHANNEL = 2;
028
029  /** Default twist axis channel. */
030  public static final byte DEFAULT_TWIST_CHANNEL = 2;
031
032  /** Default throttle axis channel. */
033  public static final byte DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CHANNEL = 3;
034
035  /** Represents an analog axis on a joystick. */
036  public enum AxisType {
037    /** X axis. */
038    X(0),
039    /** Y axis. */
040    Y(1),
041    /** Z axis. */
042    Z(2),
043    /** Twist axis. */
044    TWIST(3),
045    /** Throttle axis. */
046    THROTTLE(4);
047
048    /** AxisType value. */
049    public final int value;
050
051    AxisType(int value) {
052      this.value = value;
053    }
054  }
055
056  /** Represents a digital button on a joystick. */
057  public enum ButtonType {
058    /** TRIGGER. */
059    TRIGGER(1),
060    /** TOP. */
061    TOP(2);
062
063    /** ButtonType value. */
064    public final int value;
065
066    ButtonType(int value) {
067      this.value = value;
068    }
069  }
070
071  private final byte[] m_axes = new byte[AxisType.values().length];
072
073  private final GenericHID m_hid;
074
075  /**
076   * Get the underlying GenericHID object.
077   *
078   * @return the wrapped GenericHID object
079   */
080  @Override
081  public GenericHID getHID() {
082    return m_hid;
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Construct an instance of a joystick.
087   *
088   * @param port The port index on the Driver Station that the joystick is plugged into.
089   */
090  public Joystick(final int port) {
091    this(DriverStation.getGenericHID(port));
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Construct an instance of a joystick with a GenericHID object.
096   *
097   * @param hid The GenericHID object to use for this joystick.
098   */
099  public Joystick(final GenericHID hid) {
100    m_hid = Objects.requireNonNull(hid, "Provided HID object cannot be null");
101    m_axes[AxisType.X.value] = DEFAULT_X_CHANNEL;
102    m_axes[AxisType.Y.value] = DEFAULT_Y_CHANNEL;
103    m_axes[AxisType.Z.value] = DEFAULT_Z_CHANNEL;
104    m_axes[AxisType.TWIST.value] = DEFAULT_TWIST_CHANNEL;
105    m_axes[AxisType.THROTTLE.value] = DEFAULT_THROTTLE_CHANNEL;
106
107    UsageReporting.reportUsage("HID", hid.getPort(), "Joystick");
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Set the channel associated with the X axis.
112   *
113   * @param channel The channel to set the axis to.
114   */
115  public void setXChannel(int channel) {
116    m_axes[AxisType.X.value] = (byte) channel;
117  }
118
119  /**
120   * Set the channel associated with the Y axis.
121   *
122   * @param channel The channel to set the axis to.
123   */
124  public void setYChannel(int channel) {
125    m_axes[AxisType.Y.value] = (byte) channel;
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Set the channel associated with the Z axis.
130   *
131   * @param channel The channel to set the axis to.
132   */
133  public void setZChannel(int channel) {
134    m_axes[AxisType.Z.value] = (byte) channel;
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Set the channel associated with the throttle axis.
139   *
140   * @param channel The channel to set the axis to.
141   */
142  public void setThrottleChannel(int channel) {
143    m_axes[AxisType.THROTTLE.value] = (byte) channel;
144  }
145
146  /**
147   * Set the channel associated with the twist axis.
148   *
149   * @param channel The channel to set the axis to.
150   */
151  public void setTwistChannel(int channel) {
152    m_axes[AxisType.TWIST.value] = (byte) channel;
153  }
154
155  /**
156   * Get the channel currently associated with the X axis.
157   *
158   * @return The channel for the axis.
159   */
160  public int getXChannel() {
161    return m_axes[AxisType.X.value];
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Get the channel currently associated with the Y axis.
166   *
167   * @return The channel for the axis.
168   */
169  public int getYChannel() {
170    return m_axes[AxisType.Y.value];
171  }
172
173  /**
174   * Get the channel currently associated with the Z axis.
175   *
176   * @return The channel for the axis.
177   */
178  public int getZChannel() {
179    return m_axes[AxisType.Z.value];
180  }
181
182  /**
183   * Get the channel currently associated with the twist axis.
184   *
185   * @return The channel for the axis.
186   */
187  public int getTwistChannel() {
188    return m_axes[AxisType.TWIST.value];
189  }
190
191  /**
192   * Get the channel currently associated with the throttle axis.
193   *
194   * @return The channel for the axis.
195   */
196  public int getThrottleChannel() {
197    return m_axes[AxisType.THROTTLE.value];
198  }
199
200  /**
201   * Get the button value (starting at button 1).
202   *
203   * <p>The buttons are returned in a single 16 bit value with one bit representing the state of
204   * each button. The appropriate button is returned as a boolean value.
205   *
206   * @param button The button number to be read (starting at 1)
207   * @return The state of the button
208   */
209  public boolean getRawButton(int button) {
210    return m_hid.getRawButton(button);
211  }
212
213  /**
214   * Whether the button was pressed since the last check. Button indexes begin at 1.
215   *
216   * @param button The button index, beginning at 1.
217   * @return Whether the button was pressed since the last check.
218   */
219  public boolean getRawButtonPressed(int button) {
220    return m_hid.getRawButtonPressed(button);
221  }
222
223  /**
224   * Whether the button was released since the last check. Button indexes begin at 1.
225   *
226   * @param button The button index, beginning at 1.
227   * @return Whether the button was released since the last check.
228   */
229  public boolean getRawButtonReleased(int button) {
230    return m_hid.getRawButtonReleased(button);
231  }
232
233  /**
234   * Get the value of the axis.
235   *
236   * @param axis The axis to read, starting at 0.
237   * @return The value of the axis.
238   */
239  public double getRawAxis(int axis) {
240    return m_hid.getRawAxis(axis);
241  }
242
243  /**
244   * Get the angle in degrees of a POV on the HID.
245   *
246   * <p>The POV angles start at 0 in the up direction, and increase clockwise (e.g. right is 90,
247   * upper-left is 315).
248   *
249   * @param pov The index of the POV to read, starting at 0.
250   * @return the angle of the POV
251   */
252  public POVDirection getPOV(int pov) {
253    return m_hid.getPOV(pov);
254  }
255
256  /**
257   * Get the angle in degrees of the default POV on the HID.
258   *
259   * <p>The POV angles start at 0 in the up direction, and increase clockwise (e.g. right is 90,
260   * upper-left is 315).
261   *
262   * @return the angle of the POV
263   */
264  public POVDirection getPOV() {
265    return m_hid.getPOV();
266  }
267
268  /**
269   * Get the X value of the joystick. This depends on the mapping of the joystick connected to the
270   * current port. On most joysticks, positive is to the right.
271   *
272   * @return The X value of the joystick.
273   */
274  public final double getX() {
275    return m_hid.getRawAxis(m_axes[AxisType.X.value]);
276  }
277
278  /**
279   * Get the Y value of the joystick. This depends on the mapping of the joystick connected to the
280   * current port. On most joysticks, positive is to the back.
281   *
282   * @return The Y value of the joystick.
283   */
284  public final double getY() {
285    return m_hid.getRawAxis(m_axes[AxisType.Y.value]);
286  }
287
288  /**
289   * Get the z position of the HID.
290   *
291   * @return the z position
292   */
293  public final double getZ() {
294    return m_hid.getRawAxis(m_axes[AxisType.Z.value]);
295  }
296
297  /**
298   * Get the twist value of the current joystick. This depends on the mapping of the joystick
299   * connected to the current port.
300   *
301   * @return The Twist value of the joystick.
302   */
303  public final double getTwist() {
304    return m_hid.getRawAxis(m_axes[AxisType.TWIST.value]);
305  }
306
307  /**
308   * Get the throttle value of the current joystick. This depends on the mapping of the joystick
309   * connected to the current port.
310   *
311   * @return The Throttle value of the joystick.
312   */
313  public final double getThrottle() {
314    return m_hid.getRawAxis(m_axes[AxisType.THROTTLE.value]);
315  }
316
317  /**
318   * Read the state of the trigger on the joystick.
319   *
320   * @return The state of the trigger.
321   */
322  public boolean getTrigger() {
323    return m_hid.getRawButton(ButtonType.TRIGGER.value);
324  }
325
326  /**
327   * Whether the trigger was pressed since the last check.
328   *
329   * @return Whether the button was pressed since the last check.
330   */
331  public boolean getTriggerPressed() {
332    return m_hid.getRawButtonPressed(ButtonType.TRIGGER.value);
333  }
334
335  /**
336   * Whether the trigger was released since the last check.
337   *
338   * @return Whether the button was released since the last check.
339   */
340  public boolean getTriggerReleased() {
341    return m_hid.getRawButtonReleased(ButtonType.TRIGGER.value);
342  }
343
344  /**
345   * Constructs an event instance around the trigger button's digital signal.
346   *
347   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the event to.
348   * @return an event instance representing the trigger button's digital signal attached to the
349   *     given loop.
350   */
351  public BooleanEvent trigger(EventLoop loop) {
352    return m_hid.button(ButtonType.TRIGGER.value, loop);
353  }
354
355  /**
356   * Read the state of the top button on the joystick.
357   *
358   * @return The state of the top button.
359   */
360  public boolean getTop() {
361    return m_hid.getRawButton(ButtonType.TOP.value);
362  }
363
364  /**
365   * Whether the top button was pressed since the last check.
366   *
367   * @return Whether the button was pressed since the last check.
368   */
369  public boolean getTopPressed() {
370    return m_hid.getRawButtonPressed(ButtonType.TOP.value);
371  }
372
373  /**
374   * Whether the top button was released since the last check.
375   *
376   * @return Whether the button was released since the last check.
377   */
378  public boolean getTopReleased() {
379    return m_hid.getRawButtonReleased(ButtonType.TOP.value);
380  }
381
382  /**
383   * Constructs an event instance around the top button's digital signal.
384   *
385   * @param loop the event loop instance to attach the event to.
386   * @return an event instance representing the top button's digital signal attached to the given
387   *     loop.
388   */
389  public BooleanEvent top(EventLoop loop) {
390    return m_hid.button(ButtonType.TOP.value, loop);
391  }
392
393  /**
394   * Get the magnitude of the vector formed by the joystick's current position relative to its
395   * origin.
396   *
397   * @return The magnitude of the direction vector
398   */
399  public double getMagnitude() {
400    return Math.hypot(getX(), getY());
401  }
402
403  /**
404   * Get the direction of the vector formed by the joystick and its origin in radians. 0 is forward
405   * and clockwise is positive. (Straight right is π/2.)
406   *
407   * @return The direction of the vector in radians
408   */
409  public double getDirectionRadians() {
410    // https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/basic-programming/coordinate-system.html#joystick-and-controller-coordinate-system
411    // A positive rotation around the X axis moves the joystick right, and a
412    // positive rotation around the Y axis moves the joystick backward. When
413    // treating them as translations, 0 radians is measured from the right
414    // direction, and angle increases clockwise.
415    //
416    // It's rotated 90 degrees CCW (y is negated and the arguments are reversed)
417    // so that 0 radians is forward.
418    return Math.atan2(getX(), -getY());
419  }
420
421  /**
422   * Get the direction of the vector formed by the joystick and its origin in degrees. 0 is forward
423   * and clockwise is positive. (Straight right is 90.)
424   *
425   * @return The direction of the vector in degrees
426   */
427  public double getDirectionDegrees() {
428    return Math.toDegrees(getDirectionRadians());
429  }
430}
